title: THE WEAVE - A Malvern Buzzards Grand Day Out!
description:
Are you ready to take on The Weave?

Starting in Stourbridge and going to all five (current) Weavers Real Ale House (Stourbridge, Bewdley, Kidderminster, Worcester and Malvern). Shortest route about 34 miles.

Drink in each.

Raising funds for Cardiac Risk in the Young (CRY) in memory of Matthew Notley. Please try and raise or donate at least £34 (pound a mile).

Whether you want to go for the Fastest Known Time or plan the shortest possible route or just have a grand social, this proves to be a huge event.

The Weavers team are backing us and will be giving a warm welcome at each checkpoint. 

Shorter versions available if you only want to do a couple of stops. 

Pre-run train ride on the Stourbridge branch line. 

Gather at Stourbridge Weavers for noon, event will start at 1230.

All welcome.

Sim Buzzard 
[Phone Number Redacted]

Gather at
location: Weavers of Stourbridge, 2 Vauxhall road, Stourbridge

title: Track Session- Malvern
description: Meet at gate entrance off Thirlstane Road to College grounds. Please be prompt so we can make most of the hour. We will do a good warm up with stretching and drills (all explained and suitable for those runners new to track or advanced runners). Then a track session of various intervals ( no more than 4-5km total running) and can be adapted to suit all abilities. We will cool down and be finished by 7.30pm. 400m grass track.
